audit.why: 49.23% over 845 games with an EVEN 6/10 rating matches the text; early neutral, levels 4-6 to Aatrox, late re-even on utility. Kept.
audit.corrected: Kept; only the mechanics inside the stage text were made concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and cooldown text carried no real numbers, and phases[6].side said Poppy while win[6] said Skill — the page rendered two answers for the 2+ item row.
audit.why: Packet levelChart[6] is Skill and whys[6] describes a re-even, so the content layer was right and the full layer was the outlier.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side set to Skill to match win[6]; The Darkin Blade 14s->6s, Umbral Dash 9s, Poppy E 14s and R 140s now appear in the spike and cooldown text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text claimed Poppy's W blocks 'his R dash' and 'his Q-dash' — Aatrox's only dash is Umbral Dash (E); World Ender is a steroid with no dash. The channel-cancel and the Deathbringer Stance auto-reset tell were absent.
audit.why: Riot's text: Q is three greatsword swings (no dash), R is a form change granting AD/healing/MS. E is the dash, 9/8/7/6/5s. Poppy's R is a channel and World Ender's CC-free burst plus his damage can end it, so it is only safe once his commit is spent.
audit.corrected: W now correctly stops Umbral Dash (E) mid-flight, grounding and slowing him; Keeper's Verdict channel timed off his R; the passive auto-reset named as the wind-up tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was mentioned only as an item component, not as a timing rule against Deathbringer Stance / Umbral Dash / World Ender healing.
audit.why: All three of his heal sources are in the kit; Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Late-game text now ties Grievous Wounds to soloing him with World Ender up.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 tilt to Aatrox. His Q damage scales with points and his drain heal stacks across a long trade, while your flat base damage and percent-HP Q do not keep up in an extended fight. Your job is to keep trades SHORT — E-wall stun, Q, leave — and refuse the grind he wants. At 6 your W is gold: ground his Q-dash repositioning and block his R dash so he cannot reposition mid-combo, but his R steroid still wins the stand-and-fight all-in, so use W to escape, not to brawl.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 tilt to Aatrox. His Q damage scales with points and his drain heal stacks across a long trade, while your flat base damage and percent-HP Q do not keep up in an extended fight. Your job is to keep trades SHORT — E-wall stun, Q, leave — and refuse the grind he wants. At 6 your W is gold: it stops Umbral Dash (E) mid-flight, grounding and slowing him out of the reposition his combo needs, but World Ender still wins the stand-and-fight, so W to escape, not to brawl.
edits.note: same-length band; corrects the false claim that his R is a dash

edits.before: By 2+ items the lane re-evens on the map, not in the 1v1 — he out-drains you straight up, so do not solo him with his R available. Your value is utility: W is a hard counter to his entire engage, blocking his Q-dash and R, and E-wall peels him off your carries in every teamfight. Split when he is shoved in, group when he roams, and let your point-and-click CC and percent-HP Q matter in the 5v5 where his sustain means less.
edits.after: By 2+ items the lane re-evens on the map, not in the 1v1 — he out-drains you, so buy Grievous Wounds and never solo him with World Ender up. Your value is utility: W stops Umbral Dash (E) mid-flight, the only engage he has, and E-wall peels him off your carries in every teamfight. Split when he is shoved in, group when he roams, and let your point-and-click CC and percent-HP Q matter in the 5v5 where his sustain means less.

notes: phases[6].side was 'Poppy' while win[6] was 'Skill' — a two-layer disagreement on the 2+ items row; the full layer was corrected to match the packet chart and the content layer, so no paired content edit was needed. Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) carries a derived 'grounding' flag Riot's description does not support (drag + slow only) — no grounding claim made, matching the mirror audit.
